findings.title: Reject malformed raw evidence before granting pure-timeout eligibility
findings.detail: timeout_only accepts existing empty or schema-invalid raw documents as pure timeouts because missing complete/fatal/tests are defaulted and the test subtree is never schema-validated. Missing final raw is permitted by policy, but present malformed evidence is an unknown outcome and must not qualify a 600-second retry. Validate any present raw against the partial-driver schema before classifying; retain the explicit missing-file exception. Independent fixtures reproduce acceptance for empty TOML {}, missing tests, string complete and an empty tests mapping.

scope: Independent new pure Python/read-only readiness review; no numerical execution
